title: India Expands Crude Oil Sourcing Base to 41 Countries
summary: Diversifying crude oil import channels reduces supply vulnerability amid West Asia geopolitical tensions.

blocks.content: Diversifying crude oil import channels reduces supply vulnerability amid West Asia geopolitical tensions.

items: India expanded its crude oil sourcing base to **41 countries** (up from 27 countries earlier) to enhance energy import security.
